## Rationale

The record files stay in git history and are removed from the tree with `git rm`. Old commits still show the store of their time. The repo needs no history rewrite and no force push.

## Counter-argument

Purging the files from history shrinks the repo and removes about 27,000 files from every clone. It rewrites every commit hash, needs a force push, and cannot be undone once others hold the old history. The pack is 37 MB, which does not justify that cost.

payload.choice: Keep record files in git history and git rm them at cutover

record.subject: canon-old-history
